title: Account Suspended
description: The page Gridfall Host serves in place of any site whose account is past due, over quota or unrenewed: one paragraph, a phone number and a footer.

blocks.body: [b]This account has been suspended. Please contact your hosting provider.[/b]

If you are the account holder, call the number below and have the domain name with you. If you arrived here from a link somewhere else, there is nothing to find on this address. The site that was here is not being served and this page is what is served instead.

Gridfall Host billing and support
[b]1-888-540-2200[/b]
Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
After hours, leave the domain name and a number.

There is no charge to reinstate. An account paid before 3 p.m. is normally back the same afternoon.

items: The card on file expired and the renewal did not go through.
An invoice is more than 21 days past due.
The monthly transfer allowance was exceeded.
A mailbox on the account was used to send bulk mail.
The account was closed at the customer's request and the domain still points here.

blocks.body: Files on a suspended account are held for 90 days and then removed. Backups are part of the plan and stop with the plan, so there is no copy after that. We cannot tell you over the phone what was on the account; we can only turn it back on.
[i]This page is served for every suspended account on this host. It does not name the address you typed and it is not evidence that the address was ever ours.[/i]
